events.title: Update 1.1.0 🦀 Waifu Bubble is now compatible with Steam Deck!
events.summary: Hi, little crabs! — Patch Notes 1.1.0 🦀 Hi, little crabs! We have great news! The Waifu Bubble demo is now compatible with Steam Deck. 🎮We’ve been working to optimize the game so it runs as well as possible on a wider range of devices. We’ve also fixed several bugs to provide a more stable and enjoyable experience.Steam Deck performanceHere are the performance results we’ve achieved with the different graphics modes:Balanced: stable 30 FPS with excellent graphics. events.title: The Waifu Bubble Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: Hello, little crabs! 🦀In this demo, you can play the first 6 levels of the game, controlling our adorable little crabs as you help a waifu trapped in a bubble make her way from the depths of the ocean to the surface.
